describe: A playable chess board: 8 x 8 squares of `square` units at (`x`, `y`) with file and rank coordinates. The player moves a piece by tapping it (its legal squares get dots, captures get rings) and then tapping a square, or by dragging it there; tapping another of their own pieces switches, an empty square deselects, and a drop on an illegal square slides the piece back (`chess_snap`). Legal moves are generated in the rules (deterministic, so runs replay): every piece, captures, auto-queen promotion, and no move may leave your own king in check. Castling and en passant are not supported. Load a position by emitting `chess_load {fen}` (FEN; the side to move comes from it, the board turns so it plays up the screen when `orient` is 'auto'), or set `fen` to load one at the start. Every move, the player's or one the game emits as `chess_move {from, to}` (squares 0..63, a8 = 0, h1 = 63; `chess_sq('e4')` converts), is applied only if legal and then emitted as `chess_moved {from, to, piece, captured, check, mate, name}` (name is short algebraic like 'Qxf7#'). `chess_undo` takes the last move back (the piece slides back). State: `chess_board` (64 strings, 'K' white king .. 'p' black pawn, '' empty), `chess_turn` ('w' or 'b'), `chess_moves` (legal moves as from * 64 + to), `chess_check` (the checked king's square or -1), `chess_mate`, `chess_stalemate`, `chess_last_from`/`chess_last_to`, and `chess_locked` (set it true to ignore the player, for example while the game shows feedback). Functions for the game's rules: chess_legal_from(board, sq), chess_all_moves(board, color), chess_apply(board, from, to), chess_in_check(board, color), chess_is_mate(board, color), chess_move_name(board, from, to), chess_sq(name), chess_sq_name(sq), chess_cx(sq)/chess_cy(sq) (a square's centre on the canvas). With a `piece` sprite (12 frames: K Q R B N P white, then k q r b n p black) the pieces are drawn with it, else with chess glyphs. The board has no win or lose condition: the game decides what a move means.

piece.describe: The chess pieces: 12 square frames, white K Q R B N P then black k q r b n p, each piece centred with about 8% padding, drawn `square` units wide on its square. Give white pieces a dark outline so they read on light squares.

chess_color.body: if p == '' then '' else if upper(p) == p then 'w' else 'b'

chess_step.body: let cc = i % 8 + o.x in let cr = i / 8 + o.y in if cc < 0 or cc > 7 or cr < 0 or cr > 7 then -1 else cr * 8 + cc

chess_slide_dirs.body: if t == 'R' then [vec(0, -1), vec(1, 0), vec(0, 1), vec(-1, 0)] else if t == 'B' then [vec(1, -1), vec(1, 1), vec(-1, 1), vec(-1, -1)] else chess_king_dirs()

chess_ray.body: let cs = filter(map(range(1, 8), ck => chess_step(i, vec(d.x * ck, d.y * ck))), ct => ct >= 0) in let cj = index_of(map(cs, ct => b[ct] != ''), true) in if cj < 0 then cs else take(cs, cj + 1)

chess_pawn_moves.body: let cc = chess_color(b[i]) in let dy = if cc == 'w' then -1 else 1 in let one = chess_step(i, vec(0, dy)) in let two = chess_step(i, vec(0, 2 * dy)) in let home = if cc == 'w' then 6 else 1 in concat(filter([one, two], ct => ct >= 0 and b[ct] == '' and (ct == one or (i / 8 == home and b[one] == ''))), filter(map([vec(-1, dy), vec(1, dy)], co => chess_step(i, co)), ct => ct >= 0 and chess_color(b[ct]) == chess_other(cc)))

chess_pseudo.body: let cc = chess_color(b[i]) in let ct = upper(b[i]) in if ct == '' then [] else if ct == 'P' then chess_pawn_moves(b, i) else if ct == 'N' or ct == 'K' then filter(map(if ct == 'N' then chess_knight_dirs() else chess_king_dirs(), co => chess_step(i, co)), cs => cs >= 0 and chess_color(b[cs]) != cc) else filter(fold(chess_slide_dirs(ct), [], (acc, cd) => concat(acc, chess_ray(b, i, cd))), cs => chess_color(b[cs]) != cc)

chess_attacked.body: let up = by == 'w' in let pdy = if up then 1 else -1 in any(chess_knight_dirs(), co => let cs = chess_step(i, co) in cs >= 0 and b[cs] == (if up then 'N' else 'n')) or any(chess_king_dirs(), co => let cs = chess_step(i, co) in cs >= 0 and b[cs] == (if up then 'K' else 'k')) or any([vec(-1, pdy), vec(1, pdy)], co => let cs = chess_step(i, co) in cs >= 0 and b[cs] == (if up then 'P' else 'p')) or any(chess_king_dirs(), cd => let cr = chess_ray(b, i, cd) in len(cr) > 0 and chess_color(b[last(cr)]) == by and contains(if cd.x == 0 or cd.y == 0 then ['R', 'Q'] else ['B', 'Q'], upper(b[last(cr)])))

chess_in_check.body: let ck = chess_king_sq(b, c) in ck >= 0 and chess_attacked(b, ck, chess_other(c))

chess_promote.body: if upper(p) == 'P' and (to / 8 == 0 or to / 8 == 7) then (if p == 'P' then 'Q' else 'q') else p

chess_legal_from.body: let cc = chess_color(b[i]) in filter(chess_pseudo(b, i), ct => not chess_in_check(chess_apply(b, i, ct), cc))

chess_all_moves.body: fold(range(64), [], (acc, cs) => if chess_color(b[cs]) == c then concat(acc, map(chess_legal_from(b, cs), ct => cs * 64 + ct)) else acc)

chess_has_move.body: any(range(64), cs => chess_color(b[cs]) == c and len(chess_legal_from(b, cs)) > 0)

chess_is_mate.body: chess_in_check(b, c) and not chess_has_move(b, c)

chess_sq.body: let cc = index_of('abcdefgh', lower(substr(trim(name), 0, 1))) in let cr = or_else(parse_int(substr(trim(name), 1, 2)), 0) in if cc < 0 or cr < 1 or cr > 8 then -1 else (8 - cr) * 8 + cc

chess_parse_fen.body: let cb = fold(split(get_or(split(trim(fen), ' '), 0, ''), '/'), [], (acc, row) => concat(acc, fold(chars(row), [], (a2, ch) => concat(a2, if contains('KQRBNPkqrbnp', ch) then [ch] else repeat('', or_else(parse_int(ch), 0)))))) in if len(cb) == 64 then cb else repeat('', 64)

chess_move_base.body: let cp = b[from] in let ct = upper(cp) in let cap = b[to] != '' in let file = substr('abcdefgh', from % 8, from % 8 + 1) in (if ct == 'P' then (if cap then file + 'x' else '') else ct + (if ct != 'K' and any(range(64), cs => cs != from and b[cs] == cp and contains(chess_legal_from(b, cs), to)) then file else '') + (if cap then 'x' else '')) + chess_sq_name(to) + (if ct == 'P' and (to / 8 == 0 or to / 8 == 7) then '=Q' else '')

chess_move_name.body: let nb = chess_apply(b, from, to) in let opp = chess_other(chess_color(b[from])) in chess_move_base(b, from, to) + (if chess_is_mate(nb, opp) then '#' else if chess_in_check(nb, opp) then '+' else '')

chess_dcol.body: if chess_flip then 7 - i % 8 else i % 8

chess_drow.body: if chess_flip then 7 - i / 8 else i / 8

chess_at_disp.body: if chess_flip then (7 - dr) * 8 + (7 - dc) else dr * 8 + dc

chess_sq_at.body: let dc = floor((px - @x) / @square) in let dr = floor((py - @y) / @square) in if dc < 0 or dc > 7 or dr < 0 or dr > 7 then -1 else chess_at_disp(dc, dr)

chess_fill.body: if i == chess_check then @check else if i == chess_sel then @select else if i == chess_last_from or i == chess_last_to then @last else if chess_is_light(i) then @light else @dark

chess_coord_ink.body: if i == chess_check or i == chess_sel or i == chess_last_from or i == chess_last_to or chess_is_light(i) then @light_ink else @dark_ink

chess_piece_x.body: if chess_dragging and i == chess_sel then clamp(chess_drag.x - @x - @square / 2.0, -@square / 2.0, @square * 7.5) else chess_dcol(i) * @square * 1.0

chess_piece_y.body: if chess_dragging and i == chess_sel then clamp(chess_drag.y - @y - @square / 2.0, -@square / 2.0, @square * 7.5) else chess_drow(i) * @square * 1.0

chess_draw_order.body: concat(filter(range(64), cs => chess_board[cs] != '' and cs != chess_sel), filter([chess_sel], cs => cs >= 0 and get_or(chess_board, cs, '') != ''))

do.to: map(range(64), cs => if nb[cs] == '' then -1 else _gen * 64 + cs)
if chess_in_check(nb, nt) then chess_king_sq(nb, nt) else -1
if chess_in_check(nb, nt) then chess_king_sq(nb, nt) else -1

with.name: base + (if chess_mate then '#' else if chess_check >= 0 then '+' else '')

do.to: if chess_in_check(chess_board, chess_turn) then chess_king_sq(chess_board, chess_turn) else -1

then.to: map(filter(chess_moves, cm => cm / 64 == cq), cm => cm % 64)

then.if: not chess_locked and chess_sel >= 0 and cq != chess_sel and contains(chess_targets, cq)

children.scale: = if chess_dragging and cp == chess_sel then 1.18 else 1.0

children.text: = substr('♚︎♛︎♜︎♝︎♞︎♟︎', index_of('KQRBNP', upper(get_or(chess_board, cp, 'K'))) * 2, index_of('KQRBNP', upper(get_or(chess_board, cp, 'K'))) * 2 + 2)
children.scale: = if chess_dragging and cp == chess_sel then 1.18 else 1.0

children.text: = str(if chess_flip then cr + 1 else 8 - cr)
= substr('abcdefgh', if chess_flip then 7 - cf else cf, (if chess_flip then 7 - cf else cf) + 1)

playtest.tap_pairs: map(if chess_can_play() then chess_moves else [], cm => [chess_cx(cm / 64), chess_cy(cm / 64), chess_cx(cm % 64), chess_cy(cm % 64)])
